title: Revision-bound entity evidence
responsibility: Selects the exact revision evidence for an entity and records why before/after results may not be comparable.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.scope
inputs.description: Resolved branch/current-or-commit scope and first-parent identifier.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.revisions
inputs.description: Shown revision and parent state: undefined while loading, null when unavailable, or the stored parent revision.

inputs.name: explorerEvidence.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose scenarios and captures should be selected.

outputs.name: explorerEvidence
outputs.description: After evidence bound to the exact shown commit, and first-parent evidence only in selected-commit mode. Each side includes the chosen verdict record, applicable coverage, captures and explicit gaps. Current captures must be usable and not inherited. Scenario/state/viewport declarations from both sides are retained; differing profiles, viewport dimensions or tests are listed as comparison limits.
